x-provenance.source: Derived from openapi/brown-bdr-api-openapi.yml and openapi/brown-bdr-iiif-openapi.yml, which were themselves derived from Brown's own API documentation wiki plus live probes on 2026-08-30. Brown publishes no JSON Schema. Not a Brown-authored artifact.

responseHeader.description: Solr response header. `params` echoes the query AFTER the service applied its own defaults and clamps, which is how the 500-row cap becomes visible.

status.description: Solr status. 0 on success. Observed as 0 even for malformed queries.

links.description: Present on every search response. Carries a single `login` URL pointing at the affiliation-gated view of the same query — the API's only signal that a larger, Brown-authenticated result set exists behind Shibboleth.
